scope: Representative intermediate local breadth gate before lock refinement; one run per profile
method: Existing Sprint 11 harnesses, separate application VM/database for each case; no overlapping test/build/browser work. 50 concurrent actors, one cold round, two warmup rounds, 20 measured warm rounds. Non-owner runtime login and pool ten.

cases.limitations: Synthetic bulk fixtures; actual runtime login, tenant gates and pool 10. Fresh application per case; fixture insertion warms PostgreSQL/OS caches. Cold is first actor read. Full VM sampled every 1ms includes pools, tasks and off-heap; phase growth is reported both whole and divided by 50 concurrent workers (an aggregate, not a per-worker maximum). Individual caller heap sampled at query boundaries. JSON encoding of fetched rows measures decoded data volume, not PostgreSQL protocol bytes. TCP counters report actual aggregate PostgreSQL protocol bytes, with the per-request mean explicitly separated from decoded per-request maxima. SQL plans and pure policy compilation are separate post-load probes to avoid timing interference. Browser measured separately. No serving database writes.

limitations: Representative four-case gate; remaining full acceptance scenarios and repetitions are still required.
Cold means first actor read after fixture generation, not a cold PostgreSQL/OS cache.
VM growth divided by 50 workers is an aggregate allocation, not a measured worst-case per-request lease or allocation.
Participant p95 is close to the unchanged 500 ms budget; passing does not establish comfortable headroom.
